newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Malaysia's YTL mull power project.
newsitem.headline: China, Malaysia's YTL mull power project.

text.p: State-run China Power International Holding Ltd and Malaysia's YTL Corp Berhad said they signed a preliminary agreement that could lead to a $500 million power plant joint venture.
The two sides said in a statement that the accord forms the basis for an investment in 600 megawatts of coal-fired generating capacity in Nanchang in eastern Jiangxi province.

It said that YTL and China Power International would take 60 percent of the equity while the remaining 40 percent would be provided by the Jiangxi provincial government and the Jiangxi Provincial Investment Corp.
The statement gave no further details of the project but China is eager to install more electric power to feed its rapidly expanding industry.
The accord is one of several projects agreed on during the current visit of a major Malaysian trade delegation.
